ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_SCORCHING.title: Scorching
ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_SCORCHING.descrip: At the start of your turn, Exhaust this card and afflict a random card in the same pile with Scorching. When you play this card, remove Scorching.
ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_SCORCHING.extraCa: At the start of your turn, Exhaust this card and afflict a random card in the same pile with Scorching. When you play this card, remove Scorching.
ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_DISGUISED.title: Disguised
ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_DISGUISED.descrip: The first time an enemy gains Block each turn, transform this card into a random card from a random other character.
ILLUSIONIST_AFFLICTION_DISGUISED.extraCa: The first time an enemy gains Block each turn, transform this card into a random card from a random other character.
